# Axiom audit — Armada contract models: Vault inflation attack (#365) + shield fee (C-3) (armada-lean)
# Generated by: lake env lean /tmp/axioms_contracts.lean  (Lean 4.33.1, core Lean only, no mathlib)
#
# Source check: `grep -n "sorry\|admit" ArmadaLean/Vault.lean ArmadaLean/Fee.lean` → no matches.
# Result: all four theorems depend ONLY on Lean core logic axioms
# (propext, Quot.sound — benign, part of the trusted kernel logic).
# NO custom axioms, NO Classical.choice, NO 'sorryAx' anywhere.

== inflation_attack_profitable ==
(Issue #365, ArmadaYieldVault.sol:492-515: attacker deposits 1 into the empty
vault, donates X; after any victim deposit Y < X+1 the attacker redeems for
1 + X + Y > 1 + X — the attack is exploitable, not theoretical.)
'inflation_attack_profitable' depends on axioms: [propext, Quot.sound]

== mitigated_attack_unprofitable ==
(#365 fix: with an OpenZeppelin-style virtual offset of +1 share / +1 asset,
even when the victim receives 0 shares the attacker withdraws ≤ deposited —
the inflation attack is provably unprofitable.)
'mitigated_attack_unprofitable' depends on axioms: [propext, Quot.sound]

== fee_conservation ==
(ShieldModule.sol:336-354, audit C-3: the inclusive fee split is exact —
base + fee = amount, nothing minted or burned by _getFee.)
'fee_conservation' depends on axioms: [propext, Quot.sound]

== fee_zero_below_threshold ==
(ShieldModule.sol:336-354, audit C-3: at the production 50 bps rate, shields
below 200 base units pay a zero fee due to floor division — the SDK/spec must
reproduce this threshold exactly.)
'fee_zero_below_threshold' depends on axioms: [propext, Quot.sound]
